Copyright 2008 Google Inc. BSD-3-Clause. See Protobuf.txt and artifact-notices.txt.

Skia-derived graphics path routines
Copyright (c) 2011 Google Inc. BSD-style license. See Skia.txt.

Statically linked libc++ runtime: LLVM Project, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
and legacy license notices, reproduced in LibCxx.txt.

The runtime inventory is in runtime-components.txt. The unmodified artifacts
are used under their respective licenses; R8 transforms bytecode for packaging.
No native third-party source was modified by this release preparation.
Brand artwork was supplied by the product owner; no third-party font is bundled
(system SansSerif is used). No GPL/LGPL runtime dependency was identified in
the resolved runtime inventory. Build tools and test-only libraries are not
distributed as APK runtime dependencies.
